title: Editing a customer without AP/AR access keeps its term and limit
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A}, on a custom role, {Role-A}, that has Customers → Create & Edit but not View and Manage AP/AR Data.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-19 User and {Role-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-19 No APAR.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds Net 45 with a credit limit of $900.00.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-19 Customer.
  • An Admin can check the result in a second browser.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
  2. Change the phone number.
  3. Click Save.
  4. In the Admin's browser, open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window opens without Credit Terms or Credit Limit.
  • Step 2: the new number is typed.
  • Step 3: the customer is saved.
  • Step 4: Credit Terms still reads Net 45 and Credit Limit still reads $900.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-N4: “If the user does not have the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' setting, the server ignores any term or limit sent with their save: a customer they create gets the shop's default term, with a $0 limit when the default is COD and no limit otherwise; a customer they edit keeps its stored term and limit.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “A user without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' who creates or edits a customer has any term or limit they send ignored by the server (S5-N4).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
